messages:
Lina C: hey @it-support — I'm Lina, started yesterday. My monitor hasn't arrived (only got keyboard+mouse) and my company Mac won't join the office wifi from home. Can someone help with shipping status and quick wifi steps? I get 'authentication failed' when connecting. Shipping address on file is Apt 4B, 123 Redwood Way.

it-bot: Thanks Lina! Created ticket #68291 for IT hardware + network. Assigned to Jamal (IT). ETA for a first response: ~1 business day.

Jamal (IT): @Lina C — welcome! Sorry about the fuss. Two quick things: 1) I can check shipping/tracking, please confirm the last 4 of your order (or I can look up by name). 2) For the wifi error — are you trying to join 'redwood-employee' or the guest SSID? If 'redwood-employee', you'll need to authenticate via Okta SSO. Try this flow first: forget the network -> open a browser and go to https://login.redwood.com to trigger SSO -> rejoin 'redwood-employee' and enter credentials when prompted. If that fails, post the exact error text or a screenshot.

Lina C: thanks Jamal. I was on 'redwood-employee' — error shows: "Authentication failed (802.1x)". I forgot to get an order number; I only have the delivery email for keyboard/mouse.

Maya O: hey @Jamal @Lina C — ops here. Monitor shipments were delayed due to a batch hold with our supplier; we updated to express this morning. New tracking will be posted to the ticket by end of day; ETA now 3/26. We have VESA mounts included. Can you confirm Apt 4B?

Lina C: confirmed apt 4B, thank you. I'll try the SSO steps and post a screenshot if it still fails.

Jamal (IT): appreciated. If SSO still fails: 1) try toggling wifi off/on; 2) for a mac, in terminal run: 
```
sudo ifconfig en0 down
sudo ifconfig en0 up
```
then retry SSO. If you prefer, I can generate a temporary VPN/guest certificate for you so you can join and finish onboarding — let me know. I'll also follow up on shipping and paste the LevelShip tracking into the ticket.

Priya M: thanks for the ping, Lina — let me know if you need anything from me. Happy to help with access approvals.

Lina C: got it — trying the steps now, will report back. Thanks all! :wave:
